evidence: Row 53 (workbook Quality Checks A54/D54; quality-checks.md:212-214) asks whether the task reads as authored for this product, fits the suite's domain plan, and is not a nouns-swapped clone of a sibling (same flows, same criteria, renamed entities). AUTHORED FOR THIS PRODUCT: instruction.md:1-13 is a requester-voice request specific to HireOps (pipeline board per job + per-application staff/candidate conversation, several colleagues at once); hireops_rules.md:1-215 defines HireOps-specific roles (Recruiter/Hiring manager/Observer/Candidate, sec.1), six stages with a side Rejected lane and reopen-to-origin (sec.3), manual in-stage ordering, Interview places per job, version-based 409 with 'by whom', optimistic put-back with focus retention, bulk move in board order, single-level undo with invalidation rules, Activity lines, 15 s live updates that preserve typing/focus/scroll (sec.5), paged 30-message conversations with anchor retention, per-person unread and 'seen' semantics, per-user drafts surviving session expiry (sec.6), and candidate wording table (sec.7). Seed (environment/assets/seed_data.json) is product-specific: 10 users at hireops.example/candidates.example, jobs Platform Engineer/Data Analyst/Product Designer, 16 applications, 127 messages incl. a 120-message thread, notes, read markers, candidate_status_labels, thread_page_size 30. app_context.md names HireOps and the same accounts. All 56 criteria use the hro_ prefix and name HireOps flows. A grep of the whole frozen task for other workspace product names (Pellmoor, TorqueBay, Colderwater, Docketlight, BazaarBridge, Boardloom, Ridgeline, Threadline, GridForge, PatchPad, OrbitalOps, Drawbill, Coursemark, Utilibill, ExpenseFlow, Oriel, MedCare), 'vacancy', 'CHANGE_ME', and template probe literals returned no hits. FITS DOMAIN PLAN: task.toml provenance 'Adapted from the supplied HireOps task as a recruiting workspace' and arena_slice 'recruiting-hiring-operations' show the product/domain was assigned; NEW_TASK_AUTHORING_CONTEXT.md:203 'Reuse validated infrastructure ... but author distinct domain behavior. Do not make nouns-swapped clones.' is satisfied. NOT A CLONE: the nearest sibling is projects/pellmoor-job-pipeline (same recruiting domain, delivered 2026-09). Shared concepts exist: one-step stage moves, no duplicate email per job/vacancy, a capacity limit, all-or-none batch action, stale/concurrent refusal, activity trail (roughly 8 of 44 HireOps functional criteria touch these). But the mechanics differ materially: Pellmoor caps offers by vacancy openings with reservation/fill accounting, interview panels and 1-5 scoring, versioned assessments, d3 funnel from stage history, durable retry receipts and a reviewed batch-offer preview; HireOps caps Interview places, has hand-ordered stages, reject-reason/reopen-to-origin, undo with invalidation, live multi-user board refresh, a staff/candidate messaging half (paging, unread, seen, drafts across sign-out) and a candidate-facing portal with data-exclusion rules. Roughly 30 of 44 functional criteria plus all 5 polish criteria (live board/thread, earlier-page anchor, failed send, session resume) have no Pellmoor counterpart. threadline-chat shares only generic chat concepts (unread, drafts) inside a channel/thread team-chat product, not a renamed copy. A Pellmoor solution reskinned with HireOps nouns would fail most HireOps criteria, and a HireOps app would fail Pellmoor's, so the flows/criteria are not the same with renamed entities. LESSONS FILE CHECK: none of lessons 1-21 targets row 53 directly; lesson 12-16 patterns (checklist notes, public URLs, timing, restart, double grading) belong to rows 1/25/28/32/35. Sibling-residue scan above is the pattern instance relevant to this row and found none. OBSERVATION (not a row-53 defect, belongs to identity/metadata rows): arena_slice 'recruiting-hiring-operations' does not follow the 'full-stack-<stack>-<domain>' convention used by most siblings (e.g., 'full-stack-node-express-sqlite-torquebay-repair-operations'); it is still accurate for this task. Domain overlap with Pellmoor is a bounded customer-perception consideration, not a clone. No runtime evidence is required for this row; nothing here claims an Oracle, judge, model or portal score.
